name: Didit
long_description:
Didit is infrastructure for identity and fraud. 

Companies use one API, or our MCP server, to find out who is really behind each account: identity verification (KYC), Business verification (KYB), AML screening, authentication & user management, and fraud monitoring. 

Didit connects to the government databases and company registries and runs the document, liveness and fraud checks behind it, so teams replace a stack of vendors with one integration. 

Prices are public and every account starts free. Global coverage. Integrate in minutes, pay as you go. Start free at business.didit.me and join +4000 customers using Didit.
one_liner: We verify who is behind every account and stop fraud, through one API.
